messages:
alex: FYI grafana fired a bunch for the tokens/sec panel in west1, p99 climbed at the same time. Customers reported slow responses.
maria: seeing it too. pinned dashboard and started a quick drilldown.
grafana-bot: Alert: tokens/sec - west1 (panel 7) is firing (threshold: < 1500 tokens/s) — 3 alerts.
sre-oncall: I'll grab logs + node metrics. any known deploys? alex any traffic shifts?
alex: no deploys. traffic steady but a couple of large batch jobs from partner A started ~12:05 UTC.
jonas: pulled prometheus: tokens/sec (rate(tokens_total[1m])) shows a 60% drop at 12:06. p99_ttft pushes from 120ms -> 420ms.
jonas: hypothesis: batch jobs exhausted KV cache or caused heavy batching leading to queueing on a few GPU shards.
lina: checked node autoscaler events: west1-gpu-pool scaled down from 3 -> 1 at 11:58 due to faulty scale-down cooldown + mistaken taint. that could explain hot shards.
sre-oncall: found a flurry of preemptions on GPU nodes around 12:02 in cloud logs, plus kubelet evictions. pushing pods to remaining nodes increased per-node load.
alex: ugh. so tokens/sec drop from shortage of serving capacity -> queueing -> higher p99. paging is noisy.
maria: propose immediate mitigation: bump min size of west1-gpu-pool to 2, disable scale-down for 10m, and mute the tokens/sec alert for 15m while we stabilize.
jonas: agree. temporary terraform patch:
```
resource "google_container_node_pool" "west1_gpu" {
  autoscaling { min_node_count = 2 }
}
```
sre-oncall: applying patch now and will watch.
grafana-bot: Alert: tokens/sec - west1 resolved (instances: 0 firing). New alert: p99-ttft-west1 now still above 300ms.
alex: we should tune the alert rather than just muting forever. current tokens/sec alert is too sensitive to short autoscaler blips.
maria: suggested query change for tokens/sec alert to use smoothed rate and window and require p99 cross-check:
```
# require sustained low tokens/sec AND high latency
low_tokens = avg_over_time(rate(tokens_total[1m])[5m]) < 1400
high_latency = histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.25
low_tokens and high_latency
```
lina: also add a `for: 5m` to the alert rule and an alert annotation to link to the nodepool autoscaler dashboard.
jonas: long term: add composite alerting that gates paging on a join of tokens/sec, p99 and pod_evictions count. low noisy pages.
alex: agree. also add a tokens/sec per-shard heatmap to the dashboard so we can see hot shards instead of cluster-level aggregates.
sre-oncall: postmortem notes: root cause chain = cloud preemptions -> autoscaler scale-down cooldown interaction -> single-node hotshard -> KV cache miss amplification -> token/sec drop -> p99 increase.
maria: action items:
- temp: bump west1-gpu-pool min nodes to 2 (in flight)
- short: add 15m mute for tokens/sec alert and silence paging
- medium: update alert rule to use 5m smoothing + p99 cross-check
- long: dashboard per-shard heatmap, composite alert, and autoscaler cooldown fix
jonas: i'll open a PR for the alert rule and the heatmap panel. assign to eng-runtime + eng-sre for review.
lina: filing follow-up runbook for this pattern (autoscaler + preemption) so oncall can triage faster next time.
alex: thanks. keep this thread updated with terraform/apply IDs and any customer incidents.
sre-oncall: terraform apply done: west1-gpu-pool min -> 2. monitoring now.
grafana-bot: Alert: p99-ttft-west1 cleared.
alex: nice. please add the incident tag to the dashboard and link customer tickets.
jonas: will do. closing loop here once PRs are open and runbook is in docs.
